package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMigration020AddsHonestTerminalInteractionAndFailsClosedDown(t *testing.T) {
	_, current, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	require.True(t, ok)
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(current), "../../../../"))
	up, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/020_teacher_product_aware_onboarding_interaction_close.up.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/020_teacher_product_aware_onboarding_interaction_close.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for _, required := range []string{
		"ADD COLUMN closed_reason VARCHAR(32)", "ADD COLUMN closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ",
		"state IN ('active', 'reserved', 'superseded', 'completed', 'closed')",
		"closed_reason IN ('planning_ready', 'active_path_exists') AND closed_at IS NOT NULL",
		"reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL",
		"superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL",
		"CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teacher_onboarding_canonical_prompt_effect",
		"ON teacher_onboarding_action_receipt (dialog_id, source_message_id, source_message_version)",
		"status IN ('claimed', 'applied', 'materialized')",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(up), required)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{
		"WHERE state = 'closed' OR closed_reason IS NOT NULL OR closed_at IS NOT NULL",
		"WHERE execution_mode = 'canonical' AND status IN ('claimed', 'applied', 'materialized')",
		"RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back migration 020: terminal-close or prompt-effect fence evidence exists'",
		"DROP COLUMN closed_reason", "DROP COLUMN closed_at",
		"DROP INDEX uq_teacher_onboarding_canonical_prompt_effect",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(down), required)
	}
	require.Less(t, strings.Index(string(down), "RAISE EXCEPTION"), strings.Index(string(down), "DROP COLUMN closed_reason"))
	require.NotContains(t, string(up), "response_body")
	require.NotContains(t, string(up), "response_assistant_ui_digest")
}
